slice: Reviewed native creation and retained creation screen

criteria.original: Retains complete creation source review, intent-bound canonical draft ID, exact header/company/FIELD/composite resource identity, empty source history and explicit reason. Rejects injected status, ownership, asset, audit, history, intent and misplaced/missing creation evidence.
criteria.native: Actual command owner inserts draft/history/receipt in one owned serializable module transaction, confirms exact readback/audit, refuses existing-ID adoption, stale resources, missing facility schema and foreign receipts; receipt failure rolls back and lost acknowledgement is reconcilable with no duplicate effects.
criteria.authority: Existing app-owned role/permission, module binding and inherited native FIELD/resource access owners. Fresh resource evidence is checked outside the PERMITS transaction before and after; no PPDM_CORE reads occur inside. A post-commit failure is recoverable uncertainty, not a distributed rollback.
criteria.storage: Existing ProtectedSessionStorage owner stores one creation original per company/account/FIELD, discoverable after reload and from exact application detail, refuses replacement and verifies save/clear; binding changes cannot hide an unknown original. Actual encryption with controlled JS.
criteria.persona: Actual new-permit Razor reviews complete keys, requires reason/confirmation, protects before transport, blocks changed proposal, offers same-original recovery/resend, separately displays recorded creation and exact detail link. Static renderer and bound-input simulation only.
criteria.wire: Actual controller, Web typed client and remote-only SDK use the canonical reviewed command/recovery routes. SDK adds creation-review and shares Data target validation with Web.
criteria.retirement: Direct API/Web/native create methods, request DTO, permissive parse helpers and timestamp-ID/history helper paths are removed; obsolete direct-create tests are replaced by reviewed state/store/controller/page checks.
criteria.migration: FACILITY_TYPE is a nullable max128 canonical Data property on existing PERMIT_APPLICATION, owned by the existing Beep Migration manifest. Source-only schema change; no DDL/apply or EF migration.

Explicit country/region/authority choices do not establish company jurisdiction applicability, legal regulator approval or operation clearance.
